crossRefs.note: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when…
The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
“I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who…
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again…
Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.
Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.
There was a great famine in Samaria. Behold, they besieged it, until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty pieces of…
“Judah mourns, and its gates languish. They sit in black on the ground. The cry of Jerusalem goes up.
If I go out into the field, then, behold, the slain with the sword! If I enter into the city, then, behold, those who…
Alas for the day! For the day of Yahweh is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.

people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.
translations.bsb: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria,
translations.kjv: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.
translations.asv: And Elijah went to show himself unto Ahab. And the famine was sore in Samaria.
